Russia has launched a massive missile attack on Kyiv and the surrounding region, firing more than 30 missiles over the past 30 minutes.
The strike package included Iskander-M ballistic missiles, modified RM-48U surface-to-surface missiles launched from S-400 systems, and 3M22 Zircon hypersonic cruise missiles.
The attacks have sparked fires near Vyshneve and Brovary, as well as in Kyiv's Sviatoshynskyi and Obolonskyi districts.
